name: Economy Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public economic data.

entries.title: Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) Data
entries.description: The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis's data portal — GDP, personal income and outlays, the National Income and Product Accounts, international trade and investment, and regional economic accounts.

access.auth_note: Free BEA API registration key for the API; web portal and bulk files are open.

entries.title: BEA International Trade & Investment
entries.description: BEA's data on US international transactions — trade in goods and services, the balance of payments, and direct investment positions.

entries.title: Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) Regional Economic Accounts
entries.description: The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis's regional economic accounts, providing GDP and personal income data by state and county.

access.auth_note: Free BEA API registration key for the API; web portal and bulk files are open.

entries.title: BIS Data Portal
entries.description: The Bank for International Settlements' statistics, compiled with central banks: international banking (locational and consolidated), debt securities, credit to the non-financial sector, property prices, exchange rates, central bank policy rates, and consumer prices, with an SDMX API.

coverage.spatial: global (reporting central banks and national authorities)

entries.license: BIS terms of permitted use of statistics — use unrestricted with citation; a commercial product must not charge extra for the statistics (see notes)
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page shows the release calendar (releases dated 29 Oct 2026), a statistics catalogue, and "The BIS SDMX API web service offers programmatic access to data and metadata".
Licence checked 2026-10-31: BIS's general terms (https://www.bis.org/about/terms-conditions) send the Data Portal to its own terms: "Users may use the statistics published in the BIS Data Portal in accordance with the terms set out under the heading 'About BIS statistics'". Those terms (https://data.bis.org/help/legal, "Terms of permitted use of BIS statistics") say "The use of the statistics is unrestricted, provided that" the BIS is cited, no endorsement is implied, and, in a commercial publication or product, the statistics' inclusion "will not result in any additional charge to subscribers or other users"; "No other use is permissible." The API has its own terms on the same page. The non-commercial limit recorded here earlier came from the general website terms, which do not govern the Data Portal.

entries.title: Business Formation Statistics
entries.description: Census Bureau timeseries on new business applications and formations — a high-frequency indicator of entrepreneurship and economic dynamism.
entries.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, Business Formation Statistics

entries.title: Economic Census
entries.description: The U.S. government's official five-year measure of American business — counts and statistics for businesses and the economy by industry and geography.
entries.notes: Conducted every five years (years ending in 2 and 7).

entries.title: U.S. Census Bureau Economic Indicators
entries.description: Principal economic indicators from the Census Bureau — retail and wholesale trade, manufacturing (M3), construction spending, new residential construction, and international trade in goods and services.

access.auth_note: Free Census Data API key for programmatic access.

entries.title: Eurostat National Accounts Database
entries.description: Eurostat's official EU national accounts — GDP and its components, sector accounts, government finance, supply-use and input-output tables, and regional accounts — harmonised under ESA 2010 across EU member states.

coverage.spatial: EU member states (plus some EFTA and candidate countries); NUTS regions for regional accounts

entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (Eurostat copyright notice and free re-use of data)
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31 in headless Chromium: HTTP 200, page "NATIONAL ACCOUNTS Database" with selected and detailed datasets and a data revisions section. Eurostat's copyright notice (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/help/copyright-notice) licenses its content under CC BY 4.0. The ESA 2010 framing and the quarterly cadence for main aggregates come from Eurostat's usual metadata and weren't checked here. The generic /web/economy/database URL returned 404, so this entry uses the national accounts theme.

entries.title: SEC EDGAR
entries.description: The SEC's Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval system — public company financial filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and more), with full-text search and a REST API.
entries.attribution: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR
entries.notes: Public REST API at data.sec.gov; bulk filing archives. sec.gov 403s non-browser agents — the checker retries with a browser UA.

entries.title: Treasury Fiscal Data
entries.description: The U.S. Treasury's open platform for federal financial data — the public debt, daily Treasury statements, federal revenue and spending, and interest rates.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
entries.attribution: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Fiscal Data
entries.notes: Open REST API, no key required.

entries.title: UN Comtrade Database
entries.description: The United Nations' global database of detailed annual and monthly merchandise trade statistics by product and trading partner, covering about 200 countries and more than 99% of world merchandise trade.
entries.publisher: United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD), Department of Economic and Social Affairs

access.auth_note: Quick and advanced search are free; bulk download requires a premium subscription; the API has free and premium tiers.

entries.license: UN Comtrade License Agreement — copyright reserved; redistribution, automated downloading and commercial exploitation need prior written UN permission (see notes)
entries.attribution: United Nations Comtrade Database (UN Statistics Division)
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page advertises "Free access to detailed global trade data". It describes coverage of "approximately 200 countries" and "more than 99% of the world's merchandise trade", and marks Bulk Download "Premium subscription required". The free versus premium API tiers come from Comtrade's usual documentation and weren't checked.
Licence checked 2026-10-31: the UN Comtrade License Agreement (https://comtradeplus.un.org/LicenseAgreement) binds anyone "subscribing to the United Nations COMTRADE or using UN Comtrade without subscription", and says "any copying, automated browsing or downloading, redistribution, publication, or commercial exploitation of any material contained on or otherwise made available to you on United Nations COMTRADE is strictly prohibited without the prior written permission of the United Nations." The old terms page (uncomtrade.org/docs/terms-and-conditions/) no longer exists. It is cataloged for authority; reusers should read the agreement.

entries.title: World Bank World Development Indicators (WDI)
entries.description: The World Bank's primary collection of cross-country development data: over 1,500 economic, social, and environmental indicators for more than 200 countries and territories, spanning decades.
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31 in headless Chromium: HTTP 200. The data catalog page describes "over 1,500 indicators covering more than 200 countries and territories". It shows Temporal Coverage 1960 - 2025, Periodicity Annual, version 131 (metadata updated Oct 12, 2026), and "License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0". The cadence is irregular because WDI is refreshed several times a year, although each series is annual. Energy-almanac's world-bank-energy-mining entry is a topic slice of this same database.
